weekly_tests.title: Week 1 spelling test — The /dʒ/ sound spelt ge and dge at the end of words, and sometimes g before e, i, y
Week 2 spelling test — The /s/ sound spelt c before e, i, y
Week 3 spelling test — The /n/ sound spelt kn and (less often) gn at the beginning of words
Week 4 spelling test — The /r/ sound spelt wr at the beginning of words
Week 5 spelling test — common exception words
